nodes.text:
So, the source of this top secret research project being run by House Davion in the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCapellanMarches],Capellan Marches]] is that [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDeeJoral],lady reporter]] who was the friend of '[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreChandrasekharKurita],Bob]]'?

Darius, considering how close this world is to the Liao border it sounds more likely to be desinformation from the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMIIO],MIIO]] or the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMaskirovka],Maskirovka]].

J'oral has made it clear to 'Bob' that he owns her big after that '[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCatPeople],cat people]]' incident back at Canopian space when we saved them.

And if her source does check out, this would be quite the intelligence coup for whomever raids the alleged [[DM.Factions[faction_Davion],Davion]] laboratory on this world.

Perkele, that's why this is more likely to be a trap, the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreNAIS],NAIS]] would never set one of their top projects right outside [[DM.Factions[faction_Liao],Liao]] territory. When we land we are going to have a whole [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBattleMechRegiment],regiment]] dropped in our heads.

Not NAIS, Mr. Virtanen, we are talking here about [[DM.Factions[faction_InterconnectednessUnlimited],Interconnectedness Unlimited]], we met their CEO, Count Von Steffelbus during their failed '[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidTheAttackOfThePolymerCoatedMan],Polymer Coated Man]]' propaganda movie for House Davion.

And I remember they were stopped by [[DM.Factions[faction_SpreadingTheGloriesIncorporated],Spreading The Glories]], so 'Bob' has had his attention on IU at least since then.

'Bob' has only revealed to us this system, Von Steffelbus' company and a codeword: Zenith Initiative.

Considering what we know of IU, they are running some sort of research for their company down there since the count is known to be an eccentric.

Possibly, although that name could mean anything, Darius.

We also know that the biggest Davion companies take risks to protect their top secret research like placing them in unguarded [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePeriphery],Periphery]] backyards to avoid the attention of their domestic competitors.

Well 'Bob's source is deep inside IU's network since the contract's terms include the codes to unlock their communication protocols.

We can start monitoring their frequencies immediately to look for the lab where they have their project.

And our orders are to eliminate all IU security forces before capturing the lab where this 'Zenith Initiative' is being researched.

Considering what we know that should be mercenary or corporate forces.

branches.responseText: And what might be the 'Zenith Initiative'?

nodes.text:
Well, IU operates over several types of business, from running the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],TripleF]] burger franchise, to [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGoldenStarEntertainmentGroup],propaganda]] and even [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LorePeloranMotors],car manufacturing]].

So this 'Zenith Initiative' could be either related to any of those or it can be another of Count Von Steffelbus' weird ideas.

Maybe we are about to steal the formula of TripleF's secret sauce.

The rumor mill goes that they ship it from their headquarters to everywhere in the Inner Sphere where their burgers are sold to prevent anyone else to learn the exact composition.

[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreNewSamarkand],New Samarkand]] soy sauce smuggled in from the [[DM.Factions[faction_Kurita],Draconis Combine]].

Everyone knows that what the sauce contains but it can't be revealed because they're afraid of profit losses in the Federated Suns because of the bad publicity it would bring.

I just gained access to the local IU's network on this system and you all need to hear this.

Their [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLIDAR],LIDAR]] has just detected an incoming DropShip doing their descent burn and it's not ours!

I see it... the DropShip is the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreUnion],Union]]-class Irregular registered to the [[DM.Factions[faction_BlueStarIrregulars],Blue Star Irregulars]]. And their flight profile clearly indicates that they're heading towards the main planet... they should arrive in a matter of days.

That can't be right, the Blue Star Irregulars were last reported capturing the planet [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLiao],Liao]] under [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHanseDavion],Hanse Davion]]'s orders.

They wouldn't just divert a whole company of them here unless there's something really big going on...

Unknown force, you have transgressed into corporate property.

Identify yourself and state your intentions now or you will be considered hostile and fired upon.

Count Von Steffelbus, this is Duke Roberts of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMacintosh],Macintosh]].

I have come with orders of the First Prince Hanse Davion to shut down yours and [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMichaelHasekDavion],Michael Hasek-Davion]]'s illegal activities on this world.

Peter, we all know this doesn't has to do with my activities but with the feud between the First Prince and [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreMichaelHasekDavion],Duke Hasek-Davion]].

Stay out of this and return to Macintosh or things can get very uncomfortable.

Elric, we have also strong reasons to suspect of [[DM.Factions[faction_AppleComputersInterstellar],Apple]]'s software being illegally used in your pet project on this planet.

I could file formal charges in [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreNewAvalon],New Avalon]]'s courts for copyright violation but we would all prefer to keep this hidden from our enemies.

The First Prince's enemies are in [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSian],Sian]] or [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreLuthien],Luthien]], not [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreNewSyrtis],New Syrtis]] or here, Peter.

And the work IU is doing will change the entire Inner Sphere, which I suspect is the true reason why you are here.

You are afraid, like many others, of what the future will change and what it will mean for Apple and its glorious past.

But this is when you start reversing your company's fortune Peter, by joining hands with me and become a new partner with IU in our project.

Elric, I remember you from when you still attended the Royal Court at [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAvalonCity],Avalon City]] and you are nothing more than an opportunist and delusional.

You may hid behind your visionary ideas concerning technology but you are only loyal to yourself.

Peter, the offer still stands, just remember that when your Irregulars are defeated.

Until the interconnectiveness joins us again.
[Transmission ends.]

Whatever it is, the Davion [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTaipan],taipans]] are clearly fighting for something important enough to warrant our attention.

But what should we do now, the contract didn't mention anything about a third party joining the battle.

And the mention of Michael Hasek-Davion being involved with IU has clearly thrown this into a political fight, Darius.

The Duke of the [[DM.Factions[faction_CapellanMarch],Capellan March]] is known to be in bad terms with Hanse Davion, and we are about to step into this minefield.

If we decide to abort this contract since we were not informed that we would fight Duke Roberts and the Blue Star Irregulars, then 'Bob' might not be pleased despite the intelligence failure that justifies the contract cancellation.

Yeah, I know the intelligence wasn't 100% but we still have the access codes to all of IU's communication network.

That has got to count for something since we can use it to trick them and Apple into an ambush while they're fighting one another.

branches.responseText: True XO but we could also contact Duke Roberts instead and propose an alliance.

nodes.text:
And side with Hanse Davion against Morgan Hasek-Davion, {COMMANDER.FirstName}?

The Blue Star Irregulars will take whatever is down there after they defeat the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSyrtisFusiliers],Syrtis Fusiliers]] assigned to defend the research facility.

Yeah, but at least we wouldn't be fighting both of them, which is likely to happen once our presence in this system is discovered.

And we could also contact Duke Steffelbus instead to offer our services to IU.

branches.responseText: I want to get that research facility, let's ambush both of them.
We will contact Duke Roberts and offer our services to House Davion.
Seems like the best option, we will contact IU and help them instead.

nodes.text: We're not ambushing both at the same time, though, but I think everyone here understands what you mean.
Just be careful, those taipans can be a little arrogant and he might not like our help.
And let's hope we are not getting ourselves into something out of our control because of the Count's esoteric ideas.
That sounds too pessimistic, usually we regret after we jump into combat.
